name: CrewAI Full Examples
summary: Official collection of complete CrewAI example applications: flows, crews, integrations and notebooks.
description: End-to-end CrewAI implementations you can run, modify and deploy: multi-crew flows (content creation, email auto-responder, lead scoring, book writing), crews (marketing, recruitment, stock analysis, trip planning and more) and integrations with LangGraph, Azure OpenAI and NVIDIA models. Includes a beginner-to-advanced learning path; examples use CrewAI 0.152.0 with UV.
contains: flows: content creator, email auto responder, lead score, meeting assistant, self evaluation loop, write a book
crews: game builder, landing page generator, marketing strategy, recruitment, stock analysis, trip planner
integrations: CrewAI-LangGraph, Azure OpenAI, NVIDIA models
examples use CrewAI 0.152.0 and UV package management
each example is a standalone application with its own README
